title: Image onboarding
subtitle: Verify a container image, understand what it contains and prepare its publication on Kubernetes step by step.

source.title: Where does the image come from?
source.explain: An image is the "package" containing the application and everything it needs to run. Kubernetes downloads it from a registry every time it starts a Pod.
source.registryDesc: Enter the full reference, for example registry.example.com/team/app:1.4.2 or nginx:1.27.
source.localDesc: Pick an image already present in the Podman storage of this server.
source.referenceHint: Format: [registry/]repository[:tag]. Without registry docker.io is assumed; without tag latest is assumed (not recommended).
source.credentialsNote: Credentials are used only for this verification and are not stored. Deploying will need an imagePullSecret Secret in the namespace.
source.noLocal: No tagged image in the Podman storage.
source.localNote: Note: Kubernetes nodes do NOT use the Podman storage of this server. For the deploy to work the image must be pushed to a registry reachable from the nodes.

verify.title: Image verification
verify.explain: PKM checks that {{image}} exists on the registry, that the registry is reachable from this server, that credentials are correct and that the image is available for linux/amd64.
verify.explainLocal: PKM reads the configuration of {{image}} from the local Podman storage.
verify.demo: DEMO mode: the result is simulated, no real registry was contacted.
verify.okText: The image exists and can be pulled. Continue to see what it contains.
verify.failTitle: The image cannot be used as it is
verify.credentialsText: The registry denied access. If the image is private, enter user and password (or token) to repeat the verification.

fix.generic: Check the image reference and retry.
fix.image_format: The reference is invalid: use lowercase letters, digits, '.', '-', '_' and '/', with the tag after ':' (e.g. registry.example.com/team/app:1.4.2).
fix.registry_reachable: Registry {{registry}} does not answer from this server: check name, DNS, firewall and proxy. If the nodes use a different network, check from there too.
fix.registry_auth: The registry denies access: enter the correct credentials. Deploying will need an imagePullSecret in the namespace.
fix.tag_exists: Tag {{tag}} does not exist: check the tags published on the registry (often a typo or a version not yet published).
fix.platform_amd64: The image is not published for linux/amd64 (the server architecture): an amd64 build is required.
fix.manifest_readable: The image manifest cannot be read: the registry may use a non-standard format.

analysis.title: What the image contains
analysis.explain: This information is read from the image configuration and is used to prepare the deploy (ports, volumes, user).
analysis.noConfig: The image configuration is not available.

latest_tag.title: Mutable tag (latest)
latest_tag.text: "latest" can change over time: different nodes may run different versions and a rollback would not restore the previous version. Use a fixed version tag.

runs_as_root.title: Runs as root
runs_as_root.text: The process in the container runs as root. If it has a vulnerability the impact is larger: prefer images using an unprivileged user.

no_exposed_ports.title: No declared port
no_exposed_ports.text: The image declares no port: if the application must receive traffic, enter the port it listens on manually.

declares_volumes.title: Declares volumes ({{volumes}})
declares_volumes.text: The application stores data in these folders: without a persistent volume the data is lost when the Pod restarts.

secret_in_image_env.title: Possible secrets in the image
secret_in_image_env.text: The image contains environment variables named like PASSWORD/TOKEN: anyone able to pull the image can read them. Secrets must be passed with Kubernetes Secrets.

local_only.title: Local-only image
local_only.text: The image is on this server but Kubernetes nodes pull it from a registry: make sure it is published on a reachable registry.

dest.title: Where and how to publish it
dest.explain: PKM prepared recommended values based on the image. You can refine everything (CPU, memory, network, ingress) in the deploy wizard.
dest.name: Application name
dest.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and '-', at most 50 characters. It becomes the Deployment and Service name.
dest.replicasHint: 2 or more replicas let the application survive the failure of a Pod or a node.
dest.portNone: The image declares no port: leave empty if the application receives no traffic.
dest.healthExplain: Kubernetes uses health checks to know when a Pod is ready for traffic and when it must be restarted.

summary.title: Summary
summary.explain: Review your choices. No resource has been created yet.
summary.nextText: The deploy wizard opens pre-filled. Before applying anything it shows the summary, the generated YAML, the risks and a dry-run validation against the cluster.
